They've been taking care of my cat for many years now 😊
All the staff are true professionals when it comes to handling cats!
Even my cat, who used to be shy around strangers, became surprisingly attached to them from the very first visit.
Because of this shop, I can travel with peace of mind 🥹
I'm also grateful that they can accommodate requests even at the last minute.
Thank you so much as always!

I honestly deserve zero stars.

I'm writing this as a warning and a reminder to myself, because my beloved cat's life was in danger.

I requested their services for a week while I was traveling.

On the second day, they washed my cat with human hand soap because their fur was dirty (human skin is slightly acidic, while cat skin is alkaline, so this is absolutely forbidden).

This caused skin inflammation.

The skin gradually became inflamed, and bodily fluids oozed from all over.

Despite her worsening condition day by day, no treatment was given.

When I returned home, she was so weak she couldn't stand or even meow.

I can't believe they left her like that.

I'm amazed that the pet sitters could go home every day after seeing her in this state.

If only they had taken her to the vet when she started feeling unwell, the outcome might have been different.

Gradually, her fur fell out, leaving only skin.

As the surface of her skin peeled off, the risk of infection increased, and she became dehydrated. The local animal hospital couldn't handle the condition, so we transferred our cat to a specialized animal dermatology hospital.
A biopsy was performed at the Tokyo University of Agriculture and Technology's veterinary department, confirming that external irritation was the cause.
This means it wasn't an immune disorder, but rather caused by being washed with hand soap.

While there's an interview during registration, different people come in every day, people you've never met.

Even if a situation like ours occurs, there's no compensation whatsoever.

Even with a suffering cat right in front of them, they just leave.

You shouldn't take entrusting the life of a beloved family member lightly.

I regret asking them to take it so lightly.

I also want to apologize to our cat for suffering, getting hurt, and being left unattended as her condition worsened, causing her despair.

I urge everyone to think carefully before entrusting their pet to someone.

I hope that no more cats and their families will have to suffer like this.

Dear Zizhi Shaoo,

Thank you for using our service.

Regarding the return of the keys, we have handled it according to the method you specified in advance.

We will continue to strive to provide you with even greater peace of mind in the future.

Tokyo Pet Sitter
Ohtani

I've been using their services for about five years now, ever since the owner started pet-sitting independently. Recently, they've added more sitters, so it's not the same person every time, but my timid cats always thoroughly enjoy their time with whichever sitter it is! Even cats who usually don't come out to play when their owner invites them seem to have a great time, as evidenced by the detailed reports after each sitting. The reports, sent via LINE, include numerous photos and videos, detailing everything from feeding and elimination to playtime, health, and the extent of mess in the room.

While the sense of privacy and attentiveness that I felt when the owner was working independently has diminished somewhat as the organization has grown, they provide consistently excellent pet-sitting services, making them a trustworthy agency.

I've used their services several times, and they always send detailed reports, photos, and videos during the care process, which gives me great peace of mind!
Even my shy cats seem to feel comfortable there.

They interviewed me in advance and provided care based on the medical records they created. Thanks to the detailed reports with photos, videos, and text, I was able to ask them to take care of my pet with peace of mind.

My 16-year-old senior cats (a brother and sister). I'm so pleased with them that I'm writing this review for the second time.

I've used their services four times in the past year, for a total of about 10 days. Even when the assigned sitter changed, they remained calm and unfazed, maintaining their own pace. I also appreciate that only female sitters come. I believe they provide work far exceeding the price.

I've met four different sitters so far, and not only have there been no problems, but I can truly feel that my cats welcomed them. They go above and beyond what I've asked for, showing thoughtful consideration and anticipating my needs as a cat owner.

In my 40 years of living with cats, I've never encountered sitters I feel this comfortable with.

I'm truly grateful to have found them.

If you're hesitant, just contact them; you'll understand once you talk to the owner.

Thank you!

I used this service for the first time while traveling abroad. I was debating whether to leave my cat at a pet hotel, when I found out about this sitter and contacted them.
I asked them to help me because I thought a change of environment would stress cats.
They sent me photos and videos of their daily routine and also sent me daily updates on LINE about things we couldn't see.
Being able to see my cat from overseas was very reassuring. In addition to feeding and litter box care, they also played with my cat and sent me detailed updates on his daily life, which gave me peace of mind as a pet owner.
The fact that the staff were female also gave me peace of mind, and I was very happy that they even took care of household chores like installing a humidifier.
I would definitely use their services again when I'm away for long periods of time, and I think it was a much less stressful experience for my cat than staying at a pet hotel.

This was my first time using the service.
My child is usually shy around strangers, but from the initial consultation, they warmed up to the sitter and became comfortable.
During the trip, I received detailed reports, photos, and videos, which gave me great peace of mind!
I will definitely use the service again next time.

Thank you for your continued support.
First of all, no matter who comes, they are always gentle and attentive to my cat.
To put my mind at ease, they perfectly handle all the care I request, such as feeding, supplements, litter box toys, and grooming, and they are always accommodating any changes. The reports I read while traveling include details like the weather and room temperature for that day, which is very reassuring.
It's reassuring that they anticipate customer needs and offer suggestions accordingly. The pet-sitting is also wonderful, and my cat is completely smitten!
Everyone is also very skilled at taking photos, which I look forward to every time. I'm amazed at how they can make cats so attached to them; they're true professionals.
I would be delighted to continue our long-term relationship with you.
